title: Controlled ANSI31 hatch smoke
claims: A controlled closed polyline and ANSI31 hatch can be written to CODEX_PREVIEW and read back from AutoCAD.
The report verifies entity types, hatch pattern, bounding box, layer, and created handles.
cannot_claim: This does not prove arbitrary hatch patterns or all hatch boundary cases.
This does not prove formal-layer hatch delivery.
This does not replace project DWG acceptance.
